title: ubuntu-meta (1.450.3) focal; urgency=medium
description:
This change relates to SRU https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/livecd-rootfs/+bug/2115536.

We need to update ubuntu-meta and livecd-rootfs (handled via https://code.launchpad.net/~cnihelton/livecd-rootfs/+git/livecd-rootfs/+merge/488297) for Focal to be able to trigger a one shot build of WSL images in the new format that allows migrating out of the Microsoft Store, as we already discussed.

While ubuntu-meta's standard update procedure requires pushing all the changes caused to the various package lists by running the `/update` script, this case is special because we won't trigger builds of desktop, server etc due focal being out of standard support. Thus only the changes related to WSL are being presented in this merge proposal. Though the recent inclusion of the `wsl-setup` package in focal-updates (via SRU https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/wsl-setup/+bug/2115426) was the main reason for those changes, there were packages removed or added due seed alignment done in https://git.launchpad.net/~ubuntu-core-dev/ubuntu-seeds/+git/ubuntu/commit/?h=focal&id=70d0bae95ea450b5cb18325d52a56b9e41be9465 and subsequent commits.

This topic has been thoroughly discussed with the SRU and Release teams, motivation and allowance should be clear by now.

The following links contain proofs that the changes herein presented not only produce buildable packages but also building images from them produce the expected results:

AMD64: https://launchpad.net/~ubuntu-wsl-dev/+livefs/ubuntu/focal/wsl/+build/836983

ARM64: https://launchpad.net/~ubuntu-wsl-dev/+livefs/ubuntu/focal/wsl/+build/836984

Those images are installable on latest versions of the WSL platform and behave similarly to Noble from the platform's point of view.

ubuntu-meta (1.450.3) focal; urgency=medium

  * Refreshed dependencies
  * Added apparmor to wsl-recommends
  * Added apport to wsl
  * Added bash-completion to wsl-recommends
  * Added bind9-dnsutils to standard
  * Added binutils to wsl
  * Added byobu to wsl
  * Added cloud-init to wsl-recommends
  * Added command-not-found to wsl-recommends
  * Added curl to wsl
  * Added dirmngr to wsl
  * Added ed to wsl
  * Added file to wsl
  * Added fonts-ubuntu to wsl-recommends
  * Added git to wsl
  * Added gnome-control-center to desktop [riscv64], desktop-minimal
    [riscv64]
  * Added gnupg to wsl
  * Added info to wsl
  * Added landscape-client to wsl-recommends
  * Added libegl1 to wsl
  * Added libgl1 to wsl
  * Added libgtk-3-0 to wsl
  * Added libpam-systemd to wsl
  * Added lsof to wsl
  * Added man-db to wsl
  * Added manpages to wsl-recommends
  * Added motd-news-config to server, wsl-recommends
  * Added nano to wsl-recommends
  * Added open-vm-tools to server-recommends [arm64]
  * Added openssh-client to wsl-recommends
  * Added patch to wsl
  * Added psmisc to wsl
  * Added rsync to wsl
  * Added snapd to desktop-minimal-recommends [riscv64], desktop-
    recommends [riscv64], server-recommends [riscv64], wsl-recommends
  * Added software-properties-common to wsl
  * Added strace to standard [riscv64]
  * Added time to wsl
  * Added ubuntu-drivers-common to desktop [riscv64], desktop-minimal
    [riscv64]
  * Added unattended-upgrades to wsl-recommends
  * Added update-manager-core to wsl-recommends
  * Added vim to wsl
  * Added wget to wsl
  * Added wsl-pro-service to wsl-recommends [amd64 arm64]
  * Added wsl-setup to wsl
  * Removed dnsutils from standard
  * Moved dbus-x11 to wsl
